<!-- 10 + 11 -->
<section class="slide tint" id="structure"><div class="wrap">
<p class="eyebrow">10 / Structure</p>
<h2>Cash supports the work.<br class="dsk"/> <em>Equity rewards the outcome.</em></h2>
<p class="copy">A 6⁠–⁠12 month partnership with the first three months committed up front. Two options cover the same initial work; they differ in senior-team access and the capacity to solve problems as they arise.</p>
<div class="strip">
<div class="on"><p class="micro">Months 1⁠–⁠3</p><p>Committed up front. Defined plan and fees.</p></div>
<div><p class="micro">Day 90 review</p><p>Agree priorities, resources and fees for the next 3⁠–⁠9 months.</p></div>
<div><p class="micro">Months 4⁠–⁠12</p><p>Continue together while it is useful and mutually agreed.</p></div>
</div>
<div class="tiers">
<div class="tier">
<p class="tag">Option A</p>
<h3>Fixed scope</h3>
<p class="sub">Delivery against the agreed 90-day plan, with scheduled working sessions and coordination.</p>
<div class="price">$35,000<span class="per">per month</span></div>
<p class="total">3 months committed = $105,000</p>
<ul class="bul">
<li class="widow-delivery"><strong>Delivery:</strong> AI assessment and pilot coordination; advisor recruitment and activation; creator earnings and IP assessment; enterprise opportunity assessment and route-to-market&nbsp;recommendation</li>
<li><strong>Coordination:</strong> shared decisions and tracker with Guy, Sanyu and Philippe</li>
<li><strong>Flexibility:</strong> reprioritize within the agreed effort; material additions and third-party costs need advance approval</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div class="tier b">
<p class="tag">Option B</p>
<h3>Fixed scope plus ad hoc problem solving</h3>
<p class="sub">Everything in Option A, with Tony and Alex working more closely alongside Guy, Sanyu and Philippe as priorities evolve. This gives StarNews greater flexibility to draw on RampRate's senior team for strategic decisions, new opportunities and problems that fall outside the original workplan.</p>
<div class="price">$50,000<span class="per">per month</span></div>
<p class="total">3 months committed = $150,000</p>
<ul class="bul">
<li><strong>Problem solving:</strong> bring us questions as they come and we respond within the agreed effort</li>
<li><strong>Senior access:</strong> Tony and Alex work alongside Guy, Sanyu and Philippe</li>
<li><strong>Strategic relationships:</strong> More active pursuit of relevant commercial, distribution, content, enterprise and investment relationships, including introductions where appropriate.</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
<p class="note"><strong>Applies to both options.</strong> The same equity framework applies, as set out on the next slide. Specialist implementation costs and other third-party fees are separate from RampRate's monthly fee and require StarNews's advance approval.</p>
</div></section>

<!-- 11 -->
<section class="slide wrap" id="equity">
<p class="eyebrow">11 / Performance equity</p>
<h2 class="eq2">Equity linked to performance.<br class="dsk"/> <em>A defined ceiling.</em></h2>
<p class="copy">RampRate can earn up to <strong>5% of the company</strong> through agreed milestones, on top of <strong>1%</strong> for doing the work. The maximum total is <strong>6%</strong>.</p>
<div class="stats">
<div><div class="price">1.0%</div><p class="micro">For doing the work to your satisfaction</p><p class="small">We complete the 90 days, deliver on our commitments and set StarNews up for what follows.</p></div>
<div><div class="price">5.0%</div><p class="micro">Maximum milestone equity</p><p class="small">The pool, earned only as milestones are achieved.</p></div>
<div><div class="price">6.0%</div><p class="micro">Maximum total RampRate equity</p></div>
</div>
<div class="guarantee">
<h3>Performance Guarantee</h3>
<div><p>The initial 1.0% is staked on future success once the contract extends beyond 90 days. We are that sure we will drive tangible outcomes: if we achieve none in 12 months, we give the allocation back.</p>
<p>Returned to StarNews, or cancelled as legally appropriate, under the definitive agreement. The 12 months run from the engagement start date.</p></div>
</div>
<p class="tag" style="margin-top:34px">Share of the 5% pool</p>
<table class="pool">
<thead><tr><th>Milestone</th><th>Evidence of achievement</th><th>Share of pool</th></tr></thead>
<tbody>
<tr><td>AI decision architecture</td><td>Approved use-case map, ranked vendor scorecard and documented selection recommendation.</td><td>10%</td></tr>
<tr><td>AI implementation launch</td><td>Selected AI solution contracted and first agreed workflow live against acceptance criteria.</td><td>15%</td></tr>
<tr><td>AI operating impact</td><td>Verified improvement against a pre-agreed baseline in cost, cycle time or throughput.</td><td>15%</td></tr>
<tr><td>Founder-led advisor council</td><td>Three qualified founder or operator advisors formally engaged with signed scopes and incentives.</td><td>15%</td></tr>
<tr><td>Advisor activation</td><td>At least three verified substantive introductions or working sessions that result in agreed next actions.</td><td>10%</td></tr>
<tr class="multi"><td>Strategic relationships</td><td>Approved strategic relationship, tiered by counterparty quality. Vests once per approved relationship, so it can vest more than once.</td><td>25% / 15% / 5%<small>per relationship, by tier</small></td></tr>
<tr><td>Segment anchor client</td><td>First binding agreement with a top-20 target in any defined segment, such as a carrier, global brand or platform.</td><td>20%</td></tr>
<tr><td>Creator / talent partnership</td><td>Executed distribution, representation or creator-growth agreement with measurable commercial obligations.</td><td>15%</td></tr>
<tr><td>Content and IP commercialization</td><td>Executed licensing or catalog agreement, or first recognized IP-derived revenue.</td><td>15%</td></tr>
<tr><td>Enterprise data pilot</td><td>Signed paid enterprise audience-insights engagement that meets privacy and consent requirements.</td><td>10%</td></tr>
<tr><td>Enterprise scale contract</td><td>Executed enterprise audience or data contract with at least $500,000 in committed value, not projected pipeline.</td><td>20%</td></tr>
<tr><td>Capital readiness</td><td>Board-accepted investment narrative, financial model and diligence package prepared for a defined raise.</td><td>10%</td></tr>
<tr><td>Strategic capital secured</td><td>At least $1 million in new investment proceeds received, attributable to the RampRate-supported process, subject to applicable legal restrictions.</td><td>25%</td></tr>
</tbody></table>
<div class="terms">
<p class="small"><strong>Illustrative, for discussion.</strong> What we want from you is StarNews’ wish list and your definition of proof of success. Together we narrow it to 8⁠–⁠10 milestone categories and assign each a share of the pool.</p>
<p class="small"><strong>Deliberately overdetermined.</strong> The theoretical maximum exceeds 100% of the pool. That creates several independent paths to full achievement over 12 months, a period in which direction shifts and many outcomes depend on third parties we do not control. Vesting is hard-capped at 100% of the pool. If the cap is reached before month 12, the parties can choose to create a new pool for continued incentive.</p>
<p class="small">Partial credit only if agreed in advance. Attribution, dependencies, timing, change control, board and shareholder approvals, securities compliance and post-term tail treatment will be set in the definitive agreement, along with fully diluted capitalization and the treatment of future financings.</p>
</div>
</div>
</section>

<!-- 12 -->
<section class="slide tint" id="advisor-economics"><div class="wrap">
<p class="eyebrow">12 / Advisor economics</p>
<h2>Pay for commitment.<br class="dsk"/> <em>Vest for contribution.</em></h2>
<p class="intro">Advisors have to deliver real results to vest most of their allocation. A title alone earns very little.</p>
<div class="econ">
<div><p class="tag">01 / Define</p><h3>Agree the mandate.</h3>
<ul class="bul"><li>A written remit for each advisor</li><li>The decisions to shape, doors to open and work to advance</li></ul></div>
<div><p class="tag">02 / Commit</p><h3>Match equity to the role.</h3>
<ul class="bul"><li>Core strategic advisors: about four hours a month, with rollover</li><li>Access-led advisors: a lighter commitment</li><li>Active builders: separately scoped mandates</li></ul></div>
<div class="earn"><p class="tag">03 / Earn</p><h3>Vest against delivery.</h3>
<ul class="bul"><li>Strategic advisors: sustained participation, qualified introductions, access to decision-makers</li><li>Hands-on builders: defined deliverables, commercial progress, measurable operating results</li><li>Time-based participation where it fits</li></ul></div>
</div>
<div class="nums">
<div><div class="price">3⁠–⁠5%</div><p class="micro">Indicative advisor equity pool · company equity</p></div>
<div><div class="price">$100k–$250k</div><p class="micro">Indicative equity value per advisor · at the agreed valuation</p></div>
</div>
<p class="small" style="max-width:900px;margin-top:26px">Indicative ranges, not fixed entitlements or committed compensation. We will recommend individual grants, milestones and review points for Guy’s approval. The pool is separate from RampRate’s 1% and up to 5% milestone equity, and combined dilution, vesting, leaver terms and approvals will be modeled before any grant is issued.</p>
</div></section>
